passkeys_gone: This passkey is no longer in the vault.
passkeys_deleteBody: Kemlock forgets the passkey of {user} at {site}, on every device that syncs. The site keeps its half until you remove it there, so keep another way to sign in.
passkeys_keyNote: The passkey’s key stays in Kemlock and is never shown.
passkeys_noneBody: Kemlock makes one when a site offers to save a passkey and you choose Kemlock.
passkeys_providerDetail: Kemlock answers a site’s passkey requests, and you choose each time. Needs access to all sites and to the list of a page’s frames. Reload open pages after changing it.
passkeys_onHereDetail: Turn off to keep Kemlock out of this site’s passkey prompts.
passkeys_failed: Kemlock couldn't finish that. Try again, or use another device or key.
passkeys_locked_title: Unlock Kemlock to use a passkey
passkeys_already: Kemlock already holds a passkey for this account on this site.
